entries.004a8486dad5729b: This business manufactures and sells energy-related equipment and systems, hydrogen-related facilities, marine propulsion-related equipment and systems, plant-related equipment and systems, ships, crushers and other products. Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Ltd. (the reporting company) manufactures and sells products, Kawajū Reinetsu Kōgyo Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) manufactures and sells boilers and air-conditioning equipment, Kawasaki Machine Systems Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) sells industrial gas turbines, and Āsu Tekunika Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) manufactures and sells crushers and other products. In China, Anhui Conch Kawasaki Engineering Co., Ltd. (equity-method affiliate) and others manufacture and sell industrial machinery, environmental equipment and other products, while Nantong COSCO KHI Ship Engineering Co., Ltd. and Dalian COSCO KHI Ship Engineering Co., Ltd. (both equity-method affiliates) each independently manufacture and sell ships. The plants are the Kobe Plant (Chuo Ward, Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture) and the Sakaide Plant (Sakaide, Kagawa Prefecture), which house ship-building equipment, and the Harima Plant (Harima-chō, Kako District, Hyogo Prefecture), which houses manufacturing equipment for steel structures and other products (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥433,574 million; due to revenue increases in the shipbuilding and marine and plant fields, among others, revenue rose by ¥35.4 billion from the previous year to ¥433.5 billion.
entries.09e175e11e4d5bbe: A business that manufactures and sells aircraft, aircraft engines, space-related equipment and more.
entries.179144ff3c98e917: This business manufactures and sells hydraulic equipment, industrial robots and other products. Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Ltd. (the reporting company) manufactures and sells products, while Flutek, Ltd. and others manufacture and sell hydraulic equipment, Kawasaki Precision Machinery (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. and others manufacture, and Kawasaki Precision Machinery Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and others sell. Industrial robots are manufactured and sold by Kawasaki Robotics (USA) Inc., Kawasaki Robotics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. and Kawasaki Robotics (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. (all consolidated subsidiaries) and others, and medical robots by Medicaroid Corporation (equity-method affiliate). The Nishi-Kobe Plant (Nishi Ward, Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture) houses manufacturing equipment for hydraulic equipment, industrial robots and other products (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥259,146 million; due to continued strong hydraulic equipment sales for China's construction machinery market and an increase in robots for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, revenue rose by ¥17.6 billion from the previous year to ¥259.1 billion.
entries.1a181a9a0cde07e4: This business engages in trading, brokerage and arrangement of sales and orders, management of welfare facilities and other activities, and is one of the 6 reportable segments. Kawajū Shōji Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) and others carry out trading, while Kawasaki Life Corporation (consolidated subsidiary) and others carry out trading, welfare facility management and other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥85,839 million, down ¥4.3 billion from the previous year to ¥85.8 billion.
entries.21498807faa3e33a: This business manufactures and sells railway vehicles, snow removal equipment and other products.
entries.27b3feccea192805: This business manufactures and sells hydraulic equipment, industrial robots and other products.
entries.59c5aa2d303d4a85: This business manufactures and sells railway vehicles, snow removal equipment and other products. Kawasaki Rolling Stock Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) manufactures and sells products, and for railway vehicles for overseas markets, Kawasaki Rail Car, Inc. (consolidated subsidiary) manufactures and sells some, and Kawasaki Rail Car Lincoln, Inc. (consolidated subsidiary) manufactures some. The Hyogo Plant of Kawasaki Rolling Stock Co., Ltd. (Hyogo Ward, Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture) houses manufacturing equipment for railway vehicles (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥236,203 million; due to increases in domestic and U.S. shipments, revenue rose by ¥13.8 billion from the previous year to ¥236.2 billion.
entries.63536a1a73fb82ad: A business that makes and sells aircraft, aircraft engines, space-related equipment and other products. Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Ltd. (the filing company) carries out manufacturing and sales, and Nippi Corporation (a consolidated subsidiary) carries out its own manufacturing and sales as well as part of the shared manufacturing. As for plants, the Gifu Plant (Kakamigahara, Gifu) and the Nagoya Daiichi Plant (Yatomi, Aichi) are aircraft manufacturing facilities, and the Seishin Plant (Nishi Ward, Kobe, Hyogo) is an aircraft engine manufacturing facility (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥613,691 million; with increases in products for the Ministry of Defense and shared-manufacturing products for commercial aircraft, revenue rose ¥45.8 billion from the previous year to ¥613.6 billion. The customer accounting for 10% or more of consolidated revenue is the Ministry of Defense, whose revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥429,769 million (18.6% of consolidated revenue). The main related reportable segments are printed as Aerospace Systems, Energy Solution & Marine, etc.
entries.8af7307b0373027f: This business manufactures and sells motorcycles, off-road four-wheel vehicles (SxS, ATV), personal watercraft (PWC) “Jet Ski,” and general-purpose gasoline engines. Kawasaki Motors, Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) manufactures and sells them, and overseas subsidiaries such as Kawasaki Motors Manufacturing Corp., U.S.A., Kawasaki Motores de Mexico S.A. de C.V. and Kawasaki Motors Enterprise (Thailand) Co., Ltd. also take part in manufacturing. Sales of motorcycles and other products for the domestic market are handled by Kawasaki Motors Japan Co., Ltd., and sales of motorcycles and other products for overseas markets by Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A., Kawasaki Motors Europe N.V., Kawasaki Motors (Phils.) Corporation, PT. Kawasaki Motor Indonesia and others. The plants are the Akashi Plant of Kawasaki Motors, Ltd. (Akashi, Hyogo Prefecture), which houses manufacturing equipment for motorcycles and other products; the Lincoln Plant of Kawasaki Motors Manufacturing Corp., U.S.A. (Nebraska, U.S.), which houses manufacturing equipment for four-wheel buggies and other vehicles; and the Nuevo León Plant of Kawasaki Motores de Mexico S.A. de C.V. (Mexico), which houses manufacturing equipment for four-wheel buggies and other vehicles (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥682,812 million, the largest of the 6 reportable segments. Due to factors including an increase in four-wheel vehicles for North America and motorcycles for developed countries, revenue rose by ¥73.4 billion from the previous year to ¥682.8 billion.
